description: This file defines the LegacyGrainId class, which represents a unique identifier for grains in the Orleans runtime. It includes methods for creating, parsing, and converting grain IDs, as well as equality and comparison operations. The class manages internal caches for performance and handles serialization and string representations of grain IDs.

classes.name: LegacyGrainId
classes.description: A sealed, serializable class representing a legacy grain identifier within Orleans. It encapsulates a unique key, provides methods for creation, conversion, comparison, string representation, and parsing, and manages internal caching for efficiency.

methods.name: NewId
methods.description: Creates a new `LegacyGrainId` with a fresh GUID, representing a new grain ID.

methods.name: NewClientId
methods.description: Generates a new client grain ID with a new GUID.

methods.name: GetGrainId
methods.description: Retrieves a `LegacyGrainId` based on the given `UniqueKey`.

methods.name: GetGrainIdForTesting
methods.description: Creates a `LegacyGrainId` for testing purposes using a specified GUID.

methods.name: GetSystemTargetGrainId
methods.description: Retrieves a system target grain ID based on type data.

methods.name: GetGrainId
methods.description: Creates a `LegacyGrainId` based on various combinations of type code, primary key, and optional key extension.

methods.name: GetGrainServiceGrainId
methods.description: Creates a grain ID for a grain service based on provided IDs.

methods.name: PrimaryKey
